title: Text content
description: The `text` content block, the baseline result type that every tool result may carry.
question: Does text content reach the agent unchanged?
notes: The one content type almost everything survives. Three adapters pass it through unchanged. CrewAI delivers the characters but wraps them in the repr of the list that held them, so the agent reads brackets and quotes as part of the text. Mastra drops it.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI: the text arrives stringified inside a Python list repr, as "['SENTINEL_TEXT_BLOCK']" rather than the block's text.
notes_by_num.2: Mastra: all content blocks are dropped, text included; only structuredContent reaches the agent.

verdict.headline: Unchanged at three boundaries, reshaped at one, dropped at one.
verdict.detail: Text is the one content kind every adapter attempts to carry. Two of five change it anyway: CrewAI returns the repr of the list that held the block, so the agent reads brackets and quotes as characters, and Mastra returns structuredContent in place of any content block.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
why: This is the one content type every framework is expected to handle, so it is the control row: the other content types can only be read as losses against a text block that survives.
